# DASM Atari header

`vcs.h` is copied without changes from DASM 2.20.14.1, commit
`09270863f5f70e5200c30d2778f654ff7a40adba`, at
`machines/atari2600/vcs.h` in https://github.com/dasm-assembler/dasm.
The upstream repository license is retained as `LICENSE`.

The assembler itself is built locally under `.tools/` by `make bootstrap`.
